Siegel Center in Richmond, Virginia. Buy ticket Why We Like It It's the Rams' 2025-26 season home opener, and they'll be looking to defend their home court.See the VCU men's basketball program celebrate its 50th season in the historic Siegel Center.Enjoy the high-energy atmosphere of college basketball in a modern, state-of-the-art arena. Who Should Attend College basketball fans and loyal VCU supporters will enjoy this event, especially those eager to see the start of a new season and celebrate 50 years of Rams basketball. In the Spotlight VCU Rams Men's BasketballThe men's basketball team for Virginia Commonwealth University, a Division I program that competes in the Atlantic 10 Conference.Coppin State Eagles Men's BasketballThe men's basketball team for Coppin State University, a historically black university that plays in the Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference. About the Venue Stuart C. Siegel CenterA modern, 7,500-seat arena on the VCU campus in Richmond, Virginia, featuring excellent sightlines, an energetic atmosphere, and state-of-the-art amenities for fans.
